name: Yezza Clinic API (external access)
description:
Programmatic access to your clinic's services, appointments, queue, patients and clinical records.

**Authentication is a single header:** `X-Api-Key: yzk_live_xxxxxxxx.<secret>` (from developer.yezza.com).

You never pass a clinic id/slug or a Yezza user token — the gateway scopes every call to your key's own clinic and calls Yezza on its behalf, once a clinic admin turns on **Enable API access** in the portal.

Datetimes are ISO 8601 (`2026-05-10T14:00:00+08:00`); money is in cents (`5000` = RM 50.00). Rate limits + a monthly quota apply per clinic; `429` includes `Retry-After`.
